title: AI policy in the US government
summary: The US federal government may be the world's most consequential AI regulator. Learn whether a government AI policy career is right for you — and how to pursue it.
body_markdown:
### Get free one-on-one advice


Our team may be able to help you clarify your plan, suggest options you haven’t considered, and make introductions to jobs, funders, and mentors:
[SPEAK TO OUR TEAM](https://80000hours.org/speak-with-us/)


### Get one-on-one advice


If you want help thinking through your options, we offer free one-on-one advising for people aiming to tackle the world’s most pressing problems.
[SPEAK TO AN ADVISOR](https://80000hours.org/speak-with-us/)


### Get free one-on-one advice on your career plan


If you’re interested in working on one of the global problems we highlight, apply to speak with our team one-on-one. We can discuss which problem to focus on, look over your plan, introduce you to mentors, and suggest roles that suit your skills.
[GET ONE-ON-ONE ADVICE](https://80000hours.org/speak-with-us/)


### Thinking about your career?


If you’re thinking through how to apply this advice to your own career choices, our team might be able to speak with you one-on-one. We can help you consider your options, make connections with others working on similar issues, and possibly even help you find jobs or funding opportunities.
[APPLY TO SPEAK TO OUR TEAM](https://80000hours.org/speak-with-us/)
